description: This header file defines casting templates such as implicit_cast and bit_cast used for type conversions in C++. It includes functions for safe bitwise casting and implicit conversions, with detailed comments and examples.

methods.name: implicit_cast
methods.description: Performs an implicit conversion between types following C++ language rules, useful for safe numeric conversions and type annotations.

methods.name: bit_cast
methods.description: Creates a new value of type Dest with the same bitwise representation as the source value of type Source, used for type punning and accessing binary representations.
